entries.en: to row a champán (Chinese trading vessel); an oar.
entries.notes: 音写声调符号污损（T99）；L『remar champan』与 H『楫』、M cõ 相合，字面可读。

entries.en: to row a banca (small boat, dugout canoe).
entries.notes: H 栏字残疑（[疑:抜杭/抌杭]），M 前半难辨，义依 L；T99。
L 栏因跨页缺损作空，义依 H『學』与入声音写 hag 定。

entries.en: to remedy by amending; to correct, to amend.
to remedy and favour; to help, to protect.
entries.notes: L 缩写展开：fa brecer=favorecer，ain dar=ayudar。

entries.en: to exhort, to encourage; to advise.
entries.notes: H『勸』与音写 tang sàng 对音不合，义依汉字。

entries.en: to go about (a matter); to mediate, to manage.
to support, to back (an affair or business).
to mend, to patch; to cover.
entries.notes: H 第二字残疑（[疑:苫/荅]）；M 混入西语 tapar 字样，tâ 或即『苫』。

entries.en: to report or submit (a matter) to a superior.

entries.zh: 解送，押解（将人或物递解上司）。
entries.en: to deliver or escort (a person or goods) up to a superior.

entries.zh: 批文发往县衙；将公文转批到县。
entries.en: to send an endorsed document to the county magistrate.
entries.notes: L 云『al superior』而 H 作『批縣』，层级所指略有出入，义依汉字。

entries.en: to submit a document or petition to a superior.

entries.zh: 详文申报，向上级详细呈报。
entries.en: to submit a detailed report to a superior.
to send or transmit a document (upward).
entries.notes: 音写首字声调符号污损（T99），字面可读。

entries.en: to send (a document) to the prefectural office.
entries.notes: T99；『行府』亦可指大员行署，此处从行文至府解。

entries.zh: 批文发往府衙；向下递送公文。
entries.en: to send a document down to the prefectural office.
entries.notes: L 作『al inferior』，H 作『批府』；M 尾混入西语 al inferior，义依汉字。
